references.text: Israel's first defeat at Ai, where they fled before the enemy, now to be used as a tactical ruse
The fulfillment of the plan where Joshua and the people pretend to flee from the men of Ai
Continuation of the plan where the enemy will pursue them and be drawn away from the city
God's promise that the enemy will flee before Israel, now used as a strategic turning point
Similar war tactics where the tribe of Benjamin was lured out of the city with a simulated flight
Parallel strategy involving an ambush and simulated flight used against Gibeah
